voiceSummary: Manipal Health Enterprises Limited has uploaded the audio recording of its earnings call with analysts and investors. The call took place on November 13, 2026, at 06:00 PM. It pertained to the un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The recording is available on the company website at the specified URL. attchmntText: Manipal Health Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange about completion of acquisition of Kinder Women s Hospital and Fertility Centre
voiceSummary: Manipal Health Enterprises Limited completed the acquisition of Kinder Women’s Hospital and Fertility Centre on November 13, 2026. The acquisition involves the entire business operations and assets of the hospital located in Doddanekundi Industrial Area, Bengaluru, Karnataka. This completion follows the execution of a Business Transfer Agreement with Kindorama Healthcare Private Limited. The company previously intimated this transaction on August 17, 2026. The acquisition was finalized in accordance with the terms and conditions of the Business Transfer Agreement. This intimation is submitted under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The notice was issued by Sathish K R, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer. The filing is addressed to BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited.

Manipal Health Enterprises Limited submitted the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, issued by CARE Ratings Limited regarding the utilization of IPO proceeds. The company raised Rs. 8,000 crore through a fresh issue. The report confirms no deviation from the objects of the issue. The company extended inter-corporate deposits aggregating to Rs. 5,753.84 crore to its wholly owned subsidiary, Manipal Hospitals Private Limited. These funds were utilized for the repayment and redemption of Non-Convertible Debentures, including accrued interest and break fees. Rs. 5,552.76 crore pertained to the specific IPO object for debt repayment. Rs. 142.70 crore was utilized from General Corporate Purposes for interest and break fees accrued from June 1, 2026, to September 16, 2026. No funds were utilized for the acquisition of Sahyadri Hospitals Private Limited or other General Corporate Purposes during the quarter.

voiceSummary: Manipal Health Enterprises Limited announced financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Revenue from operations was Rs. 3,399 crore, up 37.3% year-on-year. EBITDA stood at Rs. 882 crore, up 29.8% year-on-year. EBITDA margin was 26.0%. Reported profit after tax was Rs. 285 crore. Profit after tax excluding exceptional items was Rs. 380 crore, up 21.6% year-on-year. Inpatient volumes grew 35.0% to approximately 169,000. Sahyadri Hospitals contributed Rs. 375 crore in revenue and Rs. 73 crore in EBITDA. Net debt excluding lease liabilities was Rs. 343 crore.

attchmntText: Manipal Health Enterprises Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Manipal Health Enterprises Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board meeting concluded on November 13, 2026. Revenue from operations was 1,151.13 crores for the quarter and 2,199.43 crores for the six months. Net profit stood at 164.51 crores for the quarter and 280.04 crores for the six months. Basic earnings per share were 1.31 for the quarter and 2.29 for the six months. Total assets as of September 30, 2026, were 20,635.44 crores. The statutory auditors issued an unmodified opinion on the review report.

attchmntText: MEMG International India Private Limited has Submitted to the Exchange a copy of Disclosure under Regulation 31(1) and  31 (2) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.
voiceSummary: Manipal Health Enterprises Limited disclosed the creation of a pledge over shares by MEMG International India Private Limited on 30 October 2026. The pledge involves 23,21,47,755 shares, representing 17.43% of the total share capital. The shares were pledged to 360 One Prime Limited as security for various facilities, including the MGHS and CHS Facility, Claypond Facility, MEMG India Facility 1, and MEMG India Facility 2. The total value of the encumbered shares is reported as INR 24,910 Crores. The amount involved against which shares were encumbered is INR 15,905 Crores for the primary facility and INR 500 Crores for others. The asset cover ratio is 1.5712 for the main facility. The borrowed funds are utilized for general corporate purposes, repayment of existing debt, investments, and inter-corporate deposits.
